evals.name: mechanism-cluster-not-fake-reading
evals.prompt: Synthesize six papers about manager bandwidth and newcomer learning so I can decide whether this cluster can support a JMP question.
evals.expected_output: A claim-level cluster map separating established results, disagreements, identification differences, and testable openings without creating six completed-paper records.
expectations: Coverage labels distinguish metadata, abstract, selected sections, and full text.
The synthesis identifies the nearest-paper threat and a falsifiable candidate wedge.
It does not mark papers read or update human taste without explicit learner feedback.
